## A bold vision for a more secure world

![DataGrail founders Daniel and Iz](https://www.datagrail.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/About_Us-Dan_Iz-1024x803.jpg)

Daniel Barber and Ignacio Zendejas had a big idea: what if data privacy wasn’t an afterthought, but a competitive difference for brands? That’s why they created DataGrail, a purpose-built platform that helps companies build comprehensive privacy programs that empower people to control their personal data.

Data privacy is a significant challenge in today's digital landscape. With personal data scattered across thousands of systems, it's like trying to find a needle in a haystack. Brands need help building and scaling a privacy program that minimizes risk, keeps them a step ahead of people’s expectations, and saves increasingly scarce resources in the process.

DataGrail partners with brands on their data privacy journey to minimize risk, stay a step ahead of consumer and employee expectations, and save increasingly scarce resources.

## Work with your own privacy expert

We won’t let you figure it out alone—when you partner with DataGrail, you can work with a dedicated privacy expert who will join your team to get your scalable privacy program off the ground. We’re always here to help you be more data secure.

[Managed services](https://www.datagrail.io/solutions/managed-services/)
